sourcePrompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Asset: a wide editorial lifestyle food still-life for Iraqi fast-food chain Super Sauce. Overhead photography on a vivid solid brand-red #ce1725 restaurant table, with two generous sesame beef cheeseburgers in open unprinted red cartons, one crispy chicken sandwich, a serving of golden fries, four fried chicken tenders, two small white ramekins of orange burger sauce and yellow cheese sauce, two red paper soda cups with plain white lids. A corner of red-and-white checkerboard greaseproof paper under the food. Abundant appetizing casual meal to share with friends, organically composed, hands absent, all food realistic and beautifully lit with directional daylight and natural shadows. Landscape wide 3:2 composition that fills the frame, not isolated objects. No text or logos, no watermark. Rich warm color and tactile genuine food textures.
